Question: What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS decimal(18,2)) /
    NULLIF(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN pa.Policy_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS decimal(18,2)), 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Premium prm
    ON prm.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier;

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid and the agent who sold it?

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.party_name AS policy_holder,
    ag.party_name AS agent,
    COALESCE(pr.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
) cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        ca.Claim_Identifier
) ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        pa.Policy_Identifier
) pr
    ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        MAX(pt.Party_Name) AS party_name
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    JOIN Party pt
        ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code IN ('POLICYHOLDER', 'INSURED', 'POLICY_HOLDER')
    GROUP BY
        apr.Agreement_Identifier

    ON ph.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        MAX(pt.Party_Name) AS party_name
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    JOIN Party pt
        ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code IN ('AGENT', 'PRODUCER')
    GROUP BY
        apr.Agreement_Identifier

    ON ag.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

JOIN Catastrophe c

Question: What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?

What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?
Generated Query:
WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve
    FROM Claim c
    LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim_Coverage cc
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        apr.Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICYHOLDER'
),
premium_totals AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Premium pr
    JOIN Policy_Amount pa
        ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder,
    COALESCE(pt.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_payment, 0) AS loss_payment,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_reserve, 0) AS loss_reserve,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_payment, 0) AS expense_payment,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_reserve, 0) AS expense_reserve,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_payment, 0)
      + COALESCE(ct.loss_reserve, 0)
      + COALESCE(ct.expense_payment, 0)
      + COALESCE(ct.expense_reserve, 0) AS total_loss
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_totals ct
    ON ct.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policy cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph
    ON ph.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_totals pt
    ON pt.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number, cp.Policy_Number, ph.Party_Identifier;

WITH premium_by_policy AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS premium
    FROM Policy p
    JOIN Policy_Amount pa
        ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
),
claim_loss_by_policy AS (
    SELECT
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS claim_total_loss
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        c.Claim_Identifier
),
loss_by_policy AS (
    SELECT
        Policy_Identifier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
        SUM(claim_total_loss) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_loss_by_policy
    GROUP BY Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    pp.Policy_Number,
    pp.premium,
    COALESCE(lb.number_of_claims, 0) AS number_of_claims,
    COALESCE(lb.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(pp.premium, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(lb.total_loss, 0) / pp.premium
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM premium_by_policy pp
LEFT JOIN loss_by_policy lb
    ON lb.Policy_Identifier = pp.Policy_Identifier
